en.name: Breast Reduction (Reduction Mammaplasty)
en.meta_title: Breast Reduction Surgery: Relief from Overly Large Breasts
en.meta_description: Find relief from the physical and emotional discomfort of overly large breasts with breast reduction surgery. This procedure removes excess tissue to create smaller, lighter, and more proportional breasts.
en.meta_keywords: breast reduction, reduction mammaplasty, large breast reduction, macromastia surgery, cosmetic surgery, back pain relief

what_is.heading: What is Breast Reduction? More Than a Cosmetic Procedure
paragraphs: For many women, overly large breasts (macromastia) can cause significant physical and emotional distress. Breast reduction surgery, or reduction mammaplasty, is a life-changing procedure that removes excess breast fat, glandular tissue, and skin to achieve a breast size that is more in proportion with your body.

benefits.heading: The Functional Benefits
paragraphs: This procedure is not just cosmetic; it provides profound functional relief. By reducing the weight of the breasts, it can alleviate chronic physical discomforts such as back, neck, and shoulder pain, skin irritation beneath the breasts, and deep, painful bra strap grooves. It also allows women to participate more comfortably in physical activities and find clothing that fits properly.

procedure_recovery.heading: Procedure and High Patient Satisfaction
paragraphs: Our compassionate surgeons use advanced techniques to create smaller, lighter, and shapelier breasts while preserving sensation and ensuring the most discreet scarring possible. The areola is also reduced in size and repositioned to a more youthful height. Breast reduction has one of the highest patient satisfaction rates of any plastic surgery procedure. Recovery typically involves a couple of weeks of downtime, but the relief from physical symptoms is often felt immediately.
